original: [ma.bhā] iṣyate ca, prāpnoti ca| katham? aṇāviti kasyedaṃ ṇergrahaṇam? yasmāt ṇeḥ prāk karma kartā vā vidyate| na caitasmāt ṇeḥ prāk karma kartā vā vidyate|
analyzed: iṣyate ca prāpnoti ca katham a ṇau iti kasya idam ṇeḥ grahaṇam yasmāt ṇeḥ prāk karma kartā vā vidyate na ca etasmāt ṇeḥ prāk karma kartā vā vidyate

original: (kai. ) || na caitasmāditi || nityatvāṇṇicaḥ, kevalānāṃ curādīnāṃ prayogābhāvāt aṇau karmaṇo'saṃbhavāt ṇeriti hetumaṇṇico grahaṇam, pratiṣedho'pyaṇāviti tasyaiva pratyāsattyā nyāyya iti ahetumaṇṇau gaṇasya karmatvaṃ hetumaṇṇau kartṛtvamiti sūtrasyāyaṃ viṣayo bhavatyeveti kathamatrānenātmanepadaṃ nivāryetetyarthaḥ|
analyzed: na ca etasmāt iti nitya tvāt ṇicaḥ kevalānām curā ādīnām prayoga abhāvāt aṇau karmaṇaḥ usaṃbhavāt ṇeḥ iti hetumat ṇicaḥ grahaṇam pratiṣedhaḥ upi aṇau iti tasya eva pratyāsattyā nyāyyaḥ iti ahetumat ṇau gaṇasya karma tvam hetumat ṇau kartṛ tvam iti sūtrasya ayam viṣayaḥ bhavati eva iti katham atra anena ātmanepadam nivāryeta iti arthaḥ

original: ṣṭaṣṭa13) [ma.bhā] idaṃ tarhi prayojanam - ``anādhyāna iti vakṣyāmi''| iha mā bhūt ``smarati vanagulmasya kokilaḥ- smarayatyenaṃ vanagulmaḥ svayameve''tī''ṃti|
analyzed: idam tarhi prayojanam anādhyāne iti vakṣyāmi iha mā bhūt smarati vana gulmasya kokilaḥ smarayati enam vana gulmaḥ svayam eva iti iti

original: (kai. )  ||idaṃ tarhīti|| na cānirdiṣṭaviṣayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ śakyate vidhātumiti sarvameva sūtraṃ kriyate| ||vanagulmasyeti|| karmopalakṣaṇametat| atra hi vanagulmasya śeṣatvena vivakṣitatvena karmatvābhāvaḥ| tasmāt ``smarati vanagulmam'' ityeva pradarśanīyam| ||smarayatyenamiti|| edapyupalakṣaṇam|
analyzed: idam tarhi iti na ca anirdiṣṭa viṣayaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ śakyate vidhātum iti sarvam eva sūtram kriyate vana gulmasya iti karma upalakṣaṇam etat atra hi vana gulmasya śeṣa tvena vivakṣita tvena karma tva abhāvaḥ tasmāt smarati vana gulmam iti eva pradarśanīyam smarayati enam iti e t api upalakṣaṇam

original: atra hyenamiti karmaṇaḥ sadbhāvāt``karmavadakarmakāṇāmi''ṃti vacanāt karmavadbhāvasya prāptirnāsti| nāpyanenātmanepadasya, karmāntarasadbhāvāt| tasmāt ``smarayati vanagulmaḥ svayameve''ti pradarśanīyam iti|
analyzed: atra hi enam iti karmaṇaḥ sadbhāvāt karmavat akarmakāṇām iti vacanāt karmavat bhāvasya prāptiḥ na asti na api anena ātmanepadasya karma antara sadbhāvāt tasmāt smarayati vana gulmaḥ svayam eva iti pradarśanīyam iti

original: 14) [ma.bhā] etadapi nāsti prayojanam| karmāpadiṣṭā vidhayaḥ karmasthabhāvakānāṃ karmasthakriyāṇāṃ vā bhavanti| kartṛsthabhāvakaścāyam||
analyzed: etat api na asti prayojanam karma apadiṣṭāḥ vidhayaḥ karma stha bhāvakānām karma stha kriyāṇām vā bhavanti kartṛ stha bhāvakaḥ ca ayam

original: (kai. nāsti)
analyzed: kai na asti

original: 15) [ma.bhā] evaṃ tarhi siddhe sati yadanādhyāna iti pratiṣedhaṃ śāsti tajñāpayatyācāryaḥ - ``bhavatyevaṃjātīyakānāmātmanepadami''ti| kimetasya jñāpane prayojanam? ``paśyanti bhṛtyā rājānam - darśayate bhṛtyān rājeti ātmanepadaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati iti|
analyzed: evam tarhi siddhe sati yat anādhyāne iti pratiṣedham śāsti yat anādhyāne iti pratiṣedham śāsti ācāryaḥ bhavati evaṃjātīyakānām ātmanepadam iti kim etasya jñāpane prayojanam paśyanti bhṛtyāḥ rājānam darśayate bhṛtyān rājā iti ātmanepadam siddham bhavati iti

original: (kai. )||bhavatyevaṃjātīyakānāmiti|| yeṣāmaṇyantānāṃ yat karma, teṣāṃ ṇyantānāṃ yadā sa kartā tadā karttṛsthabhāvakriyatve'pi ātmanepadaṃ bhavatītyarthaḥ| evaṃ ca bruvatā bhāṣyakāreṇa sūtrametat vidhyarthamityuktaṃ bhavati| tena ``ārohayate hastī''tyādāvanenaivātmanepadaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati|
analyzed: bhavati evaṃjātīyakānām iti yeṣām aṇi antānām yat karma teṣām yadā sa kartā tadā karttṛ stha bhāva kriyatve pi ātmanepadam bhavati iti arthaḥ evam ca bruvatā bhāṣyakāreṇa sūtram etat vidhi artham iti uktam bhavati tena ārohayate hastī ityādau anena eva ātmanepadam siddham bhavati

original: tathā hi - ruhirgativiśeṣavacana iti yaddhituparaṃ chandasi 3960|8|1|56 ityatra bhāṣyakāro vakṣyati| evaṃ ca kartṛsthakriyatvānnāstyatra karmavadbhāvaḥ evaṃ ca ``āruhyate hastī svayameve''ti ye karmavadbhāvaṃ pradarśayanti te nyāyaṃ bhāṣyaṃ ca bādhamānā avadhīraṇīyāḥ tathā hi -ṣṭaviśeṣadarśanaṃ yatra kriyā tatra vyavasthitā|
analyzed: tathā hi ruhiḥ gati viśeṣa vacanaḥ iti yat hi tu param chandasi iti atra bhāṣyakāraḥ vakṣyati evam ca kartṛ stha kriya tvāt na asti atra karmavat bhāvaḥ evam ca āruhyate hastī svayam eva iti ye karmavat bhāvam pradarśayanti te nyāyam bhāṣyam ca bādhamānāḥ avadhīraṇīyāḥ tathā hi ṣṭa viśeṣa darśanam yatra kriyā tatra vyavasthitā

original: kriyāvyavasthā tvanyeṣāṃ śabdaireva prakalpitā|| iti|
analyzed: kriyā vyavasthā tu anyeṣām śabdaiḥ eva prakalpitā iti

original: viśeṣadarśanena śabdānusāreṇa vā tāsthyaṃ kriyāyāḥ kathyate| etacca kāraṇadvayamārohaṇasya kartṛsthatāṃ pratipādayati, na karmasthatām| tathā hi - hastinamārohati, vṛkṣamārohati, parvatamārohatītyādau karmabhede'pi nārohaṇasya rūpabhedaḥ pratīyate|
analyzed: viśeṣa darśanena śabda anusāreṇa vā tāsthyam kriyāyāḥ kathyate etat ca kāraṇa dvayam ārohaṇasya kartṛ stha tām pratipādayati na karma stha tām tathā hi hastinam ārohati vṛkṣam ārohati parvatam ārohati ityādau karma bhede pi na ārohaṇasya rūpa bhedaḥ pratīyate

original: na caiteṣu prayogeṣu kriyākṛtaḥ kaścidviśeṣo dṛśyate| dhātunā ca karttṛgataiva kriyā pratipādyate, na karmagatā| kevalaṃ karmaṇaḥ kārakatvādavaśyaṃ kriyayā bhāvyamiti kriyānumīyate| sarvāṇi hi kārakāṇi svaṃ svaṃ vyāpāramanutiṣṭhanti pradhānakriyāṃ sampādayanti| bahuvaktavyaścāyamarthaḥ| kiñcit prakṛtopayogāduktamiti|
analyzed: na ca eteṣu prayogeṣu kriyā kṛtaḥ kaścid viśeṣaḥ dṛśyate dhātunā ca karttṛ gatā eva kriyā pratipādyate na karma gatā kevalam karmaṇaḥ kāraka tvāt avaśyam kriyayā bhāvyam iti kriyā anumīyate sarvāṇi hi kārakāṇi svam svam vyāpāram anutiṣṭhanti pradhāna kriyām sampādayanti bahu vaktavyaḥ ca ayam arthaḥ kiñcid prakṛta upayogāt uktam iti

original: prakṛtamanusarāmaḥ| ||darśayate bhṛtyān rājeti|| nanu karmāntarasadbhāvādatrātmanepadena na bhāvyam? ucyate - asmādevodāharaṇāt bhāṣyakārāṇāmayamabhiprāya ūhyate|
analyzed: prakṛtam anusarāmaḥ darśayate bhṛtyān rājā iti nanu karma antara sadbhāvāt atra ātmanepadena na bhāvyam ucyate asmāt eva udāharaṇāt bhāṣyakārāṇām ayam abhiprāyaḥ ūhyate

original: ``aṇyantāvasthāyāṃ ye kartṛkarmaṇī tadvyatiriktakarmāntarasadbhāve ātmanepadaṃ na bhavati, yathā ``sthalamārohayati manuṣyāni''ti iha tvaṇyantāvasthāyāṃ kartṝṇāṃ bhṛtyānāṃ ṇau karmatvamiti bhavatyevātmanepadam| evaṃ ca ``smarayatyenaṃ vanagulma'' iti kokilasya karmatve'pi pratyudāharaṇaṃ yujyate - iti|
analyzed: aṇi anta avasthāyām ye kartṛ karmaṇī tad vyatirikta karma antara sadbhāve ātmanepadam na bhavati yathā sthalam ārohayati manuṣyān iti iha tu aṇi anta avasthāyām kartṝṇām bhṛtyānām ṇau karma tvam iti bhavati eva ātmanepadam evam ca smarayati enam vana gulmaḥ iti kokilasya karma tve pi pratyudāharaṇam yujyate iti

original: 16) [ma.bhā] ātmanaḥ karmatve pratiṣedhaḥ| ātmanaḥ karmatve pratiṣedho vaktavyaḥ| ``hantyātmānaṃ - ghātayatyātme''ti|
analyzed: ātmanaḥ karma tve pratiṣedhaḥ ātmanaḥ karma tve pratiṣedhaḥ vaktavyaḥ hanti ātmānam ghātayati ātmā iti

original: (kai. )||ātmanaḥ karmatva iti|| yadaikameva vastu buddhyā pravibhajya karmatvena karttṛtvena ca vivakṣyate, tadā pratiṣedha ityarthaḥ|
analyzed: ātmanaḥ karma tve iti yadā ekam eva vastu buddhyā pravibhajya karma tvena karttṛ tvena ca vivakṣyate tadā pratiṣedhaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: 17) sa tarhi vaktavyaḥ
analyzed: sa tarhi vaktavyaḥ

original: na vā, ṇyante'nyasya karttṛtvāt| na vā vaktavyaḥ| kiṃ kāraṇam? ṇyante anyasya kartṛtvāt| anyadatrāṇyante karma anyo ṇyantasya kartā| katham? dvāvātmānau antarātmā śarīrātmā ca| antarātmā tat karma karoti, yena śarīrātmā sukhaduḥkhe anubhavati| śarīrātmā tat karoti yenāntarātmā sukhaduḥkhe anubhavatīti|
analyzed: na vā ṇi antenyasya karttṛ tvāt na vā vaktavyaḥ kim kāraṇam ṇi ante anyasya kartṛ tvāt anyat atra anya ante karma anyaḥ ṇi antasya kartā katham dvau ātmānau antarātmā śarīra ātmā ca antarātmā tat karma karoti yena śarīra ātmā sukha duḥkhe anubhavati śarīra ātmā tat karoti yena antarātmā sukha duḥkhe anubhavati iti

original: (kai.) ||naveti|| vastuta evātmano bhedo natvekasyaiva karmatvaṃ karttṛtvaṃ cetyarthaḥ| ||antarātmeti|| sāṃkhyapakṣe'ntaḥkaraṇamantarātmā, tasyaiva kartṛtvasaṃbhavāt| naiyāyikānāṃ tu matepuruṣasya karttṛtvāt sa evāntarātmā vivakṣitaḥ| ||śarīrātmā sukhaduḥkhe iti|| śarīrassyācetanatvāt sukhaduḥkhahetubhyāṃ śarīraṃ saṃbadhyata iti vyākhyeyamiti|
analyzed: na vā iti vastutas eva ātmanaḥ bhedaḥ na tu ekasya eva karma tvam karttṛ tvam ca iti arthaḥ antarātmā iti sāṃkhya pakṣe ntaḥkaraṇam antarātmā tasya eva kartṛ tva saṃbhavāt naiyāyikānām tu mate puruṣasya karttṛ tvāt saḥ eva antarātmā vivakṣitaḥ śarīra ātmā sukha duḥkhe iti sukha duḥkha hetubhyām śarīram saṃbadhyate iti vyākhyeyam iti
